info.title: karbird API
info.description: Versioned karbird REST API. Nanosecond timestamps are decimal strings.

204.description: Changed; all other sessions are signed out

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Only entries of this project.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 1-500, default 200.

204.description: Deleted with its environments, members, roles, invites, tokens and plans

200.description: Disabled; every session of the account is ended

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start, unix epoch nanoseconds as a decimal string. Default: `to - 15m`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End (exclusive), unix epoch nanoseconds as a decimal string. Default: now.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Required. Node ID the edge leaves (a service, or the environment's external-clients node).

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Required. Node ID the edge enters (a service, database, queue or external host).

parameters.name: relation
parameters.description: Required. `calls` or `depends_on`.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start, unix epoch nanoseconds as a decimal string. Default: `to - 15m`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End (exclusive), unix epoch nanoseconds as a decimal string. Default: now.

parameters.name: buckets
parameters.description: Number of buckets (default 60, max 600).

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: Moment to show, unix epoch nanoseconds as a decimal string. Default: now.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start, unix epoch nanoseconds as a decimal string. Default: `to - 15m`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End (exclusive), unix epoch nanoseconds as a decimal string. Default: now.

parameters.name: buckets
parameters.description: Number of buckets (default 200, max 1000).

get.description: WebSocket upgrade. Server messages: hello, batch, gap, heartbeat, error (JSON text frames).

parameters.name: resume
parameters.description: Resume cursor from a previous message (ingestion time, decimal nanoseconds).

parameters.name: min_severity
parameters.description: Minimum OTLP severity number (e.g. 17 = ERROR).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the log body.

parameters.name: template_id
parameters.description: Only lines of this kind: a `template_id` from a previous response (decimal string).

parameters.name: source
parameters.description:
`auto` (default): recent logs from ClickHouse, older ones from the archive.
`hot`: ClickHouse only. `archive`: the archive only (503 when it is not configured).
Ranges may span 31 days when the archive can be used, 7 days otherwise.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start, unix epoch nanoseconds as a decimal string. Default: `to - 15m`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End (exclusive), unix epoch nanoseconds as a decimal string. Default: now.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max items per signal (default 20000, max 100000).

parameters.name: live
parameters.description: Live inventory persists inactive relationships; historical ranges stay exact.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: Placement at the selected cursor, independent of relationship-range membership.

304.description: Saved graph unchanged; authorization was checked

403.description: Origin not allowed or sign-up disabled

environment_id.description: First environment of the project, to open after joining.

onboarding_done.description: `true` finishes (or skips) onboarding, `false` offers it again.

can_run.description: The caller may approve, so plans they propose run without a separate approval.

expires_at.description: Deadline for the decision (proposed) or for the executor to start (approved).

state.description: proposed, approved, rejected, cancelled, expired, running, succeeded, failed, verification_failed

allowed_here.description: Whether policy allows this type in this environment at all (demo-only check).

subjects.description: One per target, in the same order.

ActionSubjectDto.description: Where a target shows up on the System Map.

container.description: Container name in the infrastructure layer, for container targets.

service.description: Name of the map card (service or resource) the target belongs to.

actor_email.description: Email of the acting account, when it still exists.

owner_email.description: Email of an active account that becomes the owner; the acting administrator when absent.

protected.description: Cannot be deleted from the panel (the local demo project).

projects.description: Projects the account is a member of.

system_role.description: Name of the account's administrator role, if it has one.

sampling.description: Sampling configured in SDKs is not reported to karbird yet.

truncated.description: The response hit a row limit; more data exists in the range.

unresolved_processing_errors.description: Records that failed processing and are waiting in the dead-letter table.

watermark_ns.description:
Data ingested before this time (nanoseconds) has been processed into storage.
`null` when the processor has not reported progress yet.

cpu_cores.description: CPU cores in use (1.0 = one full core).

resource_id.description: Database or queue node placed in this container.

service_id.description: Service whose instance runs in this container, when matched.

unsupported.description: Capabilities that are explicitly NOT available, so gaps are visible.

expires_in_days.description: API tokens: 1–90 days (default 30). Ingestion tokens: 1–365 days, or omitted for no expiry.

secret.description: Shown once; the link is `<web app>/app/invite#<secret>`.
Returned once so local installations without email can still deliver the link safely.
Shown exactly once; only its hash is stored.

EdgeTraffic.description: Calls and bytes over one edge. Byte rates are `null` when no call in the range declared a size.

avg_request_bps.description: Bytes per second averaged over the whole range.

bucket_ns.description: Bucket `i` covers `[from + i * bucket_ns, from + (i + 1) * bucket_ns)`, by call start.

peak_request_bps.description: Bytes per second in the busiest bucket and where it starts.

is_demo.description: Demo environments must always be labelled in the UI.

source_sequence.description: Decimal string (u64 does not fit a JS number).

cpu_utilization.description: Busy CPU share of the whole machine, 0..1.

has_metrics.description: False for a machine known only from span `host.name` (no Karbird agent on it).

cpu.description: Busy share of the machine's CPU time per bucket (0–1); `null` without data.

memory.description: Used share of the machine's memory per bucket (0–1); `null` without data.

InfraBadge.description: `×N` on a service card with several instances.

InfraChip.description: Instances of one service grouped on a machine, drawn inside its frame (centre point).

InfraFrame.description: A machine drawn around the service cards running on it (world coordinates, top-left corner).

hot.description: CPU at or above 90 %, or a noisy-neighbour hint on this machine.

InfraLink.description: Noisy-neighbour link from the slowed service to the neighbour eating the CPU.

InfraTimeline.description: Machines over time and what happened to their containers.

bucket_ns.description: Bucket `i` covers `[from + i * bucket_ns, from + (i + 1) * bucket_ns)`.

truncated.description: The range holds more metric rows than were read: later buckets may be missing.

InfrastructureSnapshot.description:
Machines, containers and service instances at one moment, as returned by
`GET /api/v1/projects/{project}/environments/{env}/infrastructure`.

notes.description: What could not be determined (no agent metrics, unmatched instances, truncation).

resources.description:
Databases and queues on the map and where they run: on a machine with the agent
(internal) or not (external).

window_ns.description: Machine metrics are read from `[at - window, at]`.

baseline_p95_ms.description: p95 in the 30 minutes before that.

p95_ms.description: p95 of request spans in the last 5 minutes before `at`.

InstanceMatch.description: How an instance was placed on a machine.

prefix.description: Non-secret start of the link's secret, for telling links apart.

already_member.description: Signed in and already a member of the project.

signed_in.description: Whether the request came with a browser session.

body.description: Untrusted text. Render as plain text only.

template_id.description:
Lines of one kind (the body with its numbers and IDs taken out) share this ID.
Decimal string (u64 does not fit a JS number); `"0"` for rows stored before templates.

source.description: Where the rows were read from.

based_on.description: For an individual set: the role it was derived from (display only).

role.description: Built-in role key, `custom` for a role template or `individual` for an individual set.

based_on.description: With `permissions`: the role the set was derived from, shown as "Individual, based on …".

NoisyNeighborHint.description:
Deterministic rule (no LLM): an instance got slower while a neighbour on the same machine
used most of its CPU.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of which thresholds fired.

boolean.description: An on/off switch, sent as the integer 0 or 1.

new_password.description: Same rules as at sign-up (at least 12 characters, not the email).

PolicyDto.description: Schema of the stored policy decision (serialized `karbird_actions::PolicyDecision`).

permissions.description: Effective permission ids in this project (see `GET /api/v1/permissions`).

role.description:
Built-in role key (`owner`, `admin`, `operator`, `viewer`), `custom` for a role template or
`individual` for an individual permission set. API tokens always report `viewer`.

role_name.description: Display name of the role (template name, or `Individual`).

display_name.description: Shown in the UI; defaults to the part of the email before `@`.

ResourceLocation.description: Where a database or queue runs, derived from the addresses services connect to it at.

addresses.description: `address:port` the services connect to, at most a few.

node_id.description: Topology node ID of the database or queue.

reason.description: Why it was placed (or not), for people.

builtin.description: `owner`, `admin`, `operator` or `viewer` for built-in (read-only) roles; absent for templates.

grace_seconds.description: Seconds the old token keeps working (0–86400, default 0) so running senders can switch.

signals.description: Signals seen for this service in the range (`traces`, `logs`).

current.description: The session this request was made with.

oneOf.description: karbird administrator access; absent for everyone else and for API tokens.

kind.description: OTLP SpanKind: 0 unspecified, 1 internal, 2 server, 3 client, 4 producer, 5 consumer.

source_entity_id.description: Uninstrumented caller of a root server span (an external client node), when known.

target_entity_id.description: Resource / dependency entity this span calls (e.g. a database), when known.

SystemAccessDto.description: The signed-in user's administrator access, for the session payload (`None` without any).

TimelineItem.description:
One recorded item. IDs are the deduplication keys: applying the same item
twice has no additional effect.

TimelineResponse.description: Directly consumable by the engine's `applyBatch` (it reads `items`).

logs_source.description:
Where the log items come from: the archive serves the part of the range before the hot
window. Spans and events are never archived.

spans_truncated.description: Per-signal truncation: when true, the range holds more items than returned.

reasons.description: Evidence for inferred relationships. No numeric confidence is invented.

TopologyResponse.description: Superset of the engine's `TopologySnapshot`; the Worker passes it to WASM unchanged.

oneOf.description:
Machine frames, instance chips and noisy-neighbour links; only with the infrastructure
layer on and a snapshot loaded.

revision.description: Serialized as a JSON number (values stay far below 2^53).

points.description:
Corridor waypoints `[x, y]` (world coordinates) where the edge crosses intermediate
layout columns; empty for edges between adjacent columns.

missing_parent_span_ids.description:
Parent span IDs referenced by spans in this trace but not recorded
(not instrumented, sampled out, dropped or still in flight).

onboarding_done.description: Onboarding finished or skipped; it is offered, never required.

api_token.description: Read-only API token (cha_…) bound to one environment; GET only.

tags.name: admin
tags.description: karbird administration: every project, account and administrator (browser sessions only)
